IBM.rationale: IBM's fundamentals are genuinely improving — Q1 2026 showed +9.5% YoY revenue growth, +14.3% EPS growth, 100bp gross margin expansion, and exceptional OCF of 5.17B (4.2x net income). The software pivot is working with 11% growth, and the Z mainframe moat remains formidable with 51% hardware revenue growth. However, the stock is not cheap at 25.6x trailing PE with a 3.9% earnings yield below the 4.49% risk-free rate, offering no equity risk premium. The balance sheet carries 3.7x D/E leverage from acquisition-driven strategy. The recent +19.1% Q2 rally has already captured much of the Q1 surprise, leaving ~13% below the 52-week high. Consulting is structurally challenged at 1% growth, and watsonx AI bookings ($12.5B cumulative) remain unconverted pipeline. Q2 earnings on July 22 provide a modest near-term catalyst but expectations are only +5.7% YoY EPS growth, limiting upside surprise potential. Net: quality franchise in transition, but valuation and leverage cap the score at mildly positive.
